homograph.note: The verb (to approve officially) and the plural noun (penalties imposed on a country) point in opposite directions, so a learner who knows one cannot guess the other. A hint must say which sense it targets; the exam tested the approval sense.

senses.definition: to give official permission or approval for an action or a plan

examples.en: The council refused to sanction the building of a second road.
examples.fa: شورا از تأیید رسمیِ ساخت جادهٔ دوم خودداری کرد.

senses.definition: an official order that limits trade with a country in order to force it to change, usually used in the plural

examples.en: The country lived under economic sanctions for almost a decade.
examples.fa: آن کشور نزدیک به یک دهه زیر تحریم‌های اقتصادی زندگی کرد.
